title: Cities & districts
subtitle: The cities and their districts as stores are served from: select a city to see its districts, the store that serves each one and its location.

access.deniedTitle: No access to cities and districts
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the grant for cities and districts. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

import.title: Import cities
import.format: One city per line, its columns separated by tabs as WPF reads them: city code, English name, Arabic name. Add a fourth column holding X to delete that city. There is no header row: a header would be read as a city.

districts.title: Districts
districts.selectCity: Select a city above to see its districts.

districts.exported_other: {{n}} districts were written to the workbook.

import.title: Import districts
import.format: One district per line, its columns separated by tabs as WPF reads them: district code, city code, English name, Arabic name, Magento city (EN), Magento city (AR), store, insurance store, temporary store. Add a tenth column holding X to delete that district. There is no header row: a header would be read as a district.
